details.completeness_justification: All key information units are adequately represented in the candidate summary. K1 is covered by S2 and S3 (revenue increase and drivers). K2 is covered by S7 and S9 (net profit and EBITDA). K3 is covered by S11 (adjusted EBITDA). K4 is covered by S4, S5, and S6 (natural gas cost decrease and reasons). K5 is covered by S13 and S14 (borrowings reclassification and net debt increase). K6 is covered by S16 (litigation and provision). K7 is covered by S17 (dividend declaration at General Meeting).
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. All statements are logically connected and support the overall narrative of improved financial performance. There are no self-contradictions, logical gaps, or organizational issues. The summary flows logically from revenue growth to expense reductions, profitability metrics, balance sheet changes, and concluding remarks about legal matters and dividends. While there is a significant jump between adjusted EBITDA (EUR 8,285 thousand) and reported EBITDA (EUR 23,304 thousand), the summary does not claim these figures are directly comparable or part of the same calculation, so this does not constitute an internal contradiction. The balance sheet movements (net debt, cash, equity) are explained with plausible reasons without conflicting statements. No unnecessary repetition materially reduces clarity.
